Module Contents
---------------

Classes
~~~~~~~

.. autoapisummary::

   futuram.classes.processes.Process




.. py:class:: Process(name)


   A class representing a process that transforms input flows into output flows.

   .. attribute:: name

      The name of the process.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: description

      A description of the process.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: tags

      A list of tags associated with the process.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: WS

      A list of waste streams associated with the process.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: inputs

      A list of input flows to the process.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: outputs

      A list of output flows from the process.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: parameters

      A list of parameters associated with the process.

      :type: list

   .. py:method:: print_transfer_coefficients()

      Prints the transfer coefficients of the process in a nice table


   .. py:method:: print_flows()

      Prints the input and output flows of the process in a nice table


   .. py:method:: print_table()


   .. py:method:: add_transfer_coefficient(flow_input, flow_output, transfer_coefficient, uncertainty)

      Adds a transfer coefficient to the process.

      :param input: The input flow.
      :type input: str
      :param output: The output flow.
      :type output: str
      :param transfer_coefficient: The transfer coefficient.
      :type transfer_coefficient: float
      :param uncertainty: The uncertainty of the transfer coefficient.
      :type uncertainty: float


   .. py:method:: add_to_model(model)


   .. py:method:: add_input(flow)

      Adds an input flow to the process.

      :param flow: The input flow to add.
      :type flow: Flow


   .. py:method:: add_output(flow)

      Adds an output flow to the process.

      :param flow: The output flow to add.
      :type flow: Flow


   .. py:method:: remove_input(flow)

      Removes an input flow from the process.

      :param flow: The input flow to remove.
      :type flow: Flow


   .. py:method:: remove_output(flow)

      Removes an output flow from the process.

      :param flow: The output flow to remove.
      :type flow: Flow


   .. py:method:: clear_inputs()

      Clears all input flows from the process.


   .. py:method:: clear_outputs()

      Clears all output flows from the process.


   .. py:method:: get_total_input_flow()

      Calculates the total input flow to the process.

      :returns: The total input flow to the process.


   .. py:method:: get_total_output_flow()

      Calculates the total output flow from the process.

      :returns: The total output flow from the process.


   .. py:method:: add_transform_flow(flow, function)

      Transforms an input flow and adds the resulting output flow to the process.

      :param flow: The input flow to transform.
      :type flow: Flow
      :param function: The function to use for the transformation.
      :type function: function


   .. py:method:: has_input(flow)

      Checks if an input flow is associated with the process.

      :param flow: The input flow to check.
      :type flow: Flow

      :returns: True if the input flow is associated with the process, False otherwise.


   .. py:method:: has_output(flow)

      Checks if an output flow is associated with the process.

      :param flow: The output flow to check.
      :type flow: Flow

      :returns: True if the output flow is associated with the process, False otherwise.


   .. py:method:: has_tag(tag)

      Checks if a tag is associated with the process.

      :param tag: The tag to check.
      :type tag: str

      :returns: True if the tag is associated with the process, False otherwise.


   .. py:method:: add_parameter(parameter)

      Adds a parameter to the process.

      :param parameter: The parameter to add.


   .. py:method:: remove_parameter(parameter)

      Removes a parameter from the process.

      :param parameter: The parameter to remove.


   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Converts the process to a dictionary.

      :returns: A dictionary representation of the process.


   .. py:method:: make_flowchart()

      Creates an isolated process flow diagram for
      the process, showing only the direct inputs and outputs.
      This is only reversing the syntax really,
      it uses the function from the visualisation module.


   .. py:method:: output_table()

      Creates a table of the output flows of the process.

      :returns: A table of the output flows of the process.


   .. py:method:: input_table()

      Creates a table of the input flows of the process.

      :returns: A table of the input flows of the process.
